Smart lighting may be the quickest and easiest way to transform a space. We at WIRED have been writing about it more and more recently because it can spruce up your home decor, bring a futuristic feel, enhance your entertainment with synced lights, or simply change the vibe of a space for less than a full home renovation. Lighting brand Govee has quickly become one of our favorite smart lighting brands for its versatile and affordable range. We’ve extensively tested Govee products, and we feel there’s a Govee smart ligh t for pretty much every need, room, or vibe.
When you register your email, you’ll get a $5 Govee coupon for your first order. Just apply the code at checkout. Why not give the gift of good lighting? When you refer a friend, you can also get a $5 discount. As you know, sharing is caring, and the referred friend also receives $5 off their purchase. (Both must be first-time purchases at Govee to qualify.)
Govee’s expansive lineup can be a bit confusing, but we have a handy guide that explains each smart light and which room (and person) will work best with each light. We named the Govee M1 LED Light Strip the best overall for its blazing-bright, vibrant color LEDs and surprising affordability—this light strip is perfect for recessed areas in your home.
We also named the Govee Glide Hexa Pro 3D Panels as our pick for the best panels. If you’re looking to seriously up the hypnotizing-yet-chill stoner-esque aesthetic, we like these panels for their unique animated effects and ability to sync to music or connect to your existing RGB gaming setup. Speaking of gaming, we named the Govee AI Gaming Sync Box Kit the best lights for gaming, which reviewer Simon Hill praised as “easily one of the best smart lighting options for gamers.” He rated it as an 8/10. WIRED recommends it for its vibrant colors, accurate screen syncing, versatility, ability to customize, and, as a plus, it works with Google Home or Amazon Alexa.
The Govee Envisual T2 is the best light for your TV, as it syncs lights to what’s happening on your TV to turn your living room into your own personal IMAX-esque experience. Prefer being outside? We named the Govee Permanent Outdoor Lights Pro as our favorite outdoor light, even putting it in our Best Christmas Lights guide. We liked the ability to customize the lights via the app, which has a wide choice of animated scenes covering different holidays, tons of colorful styles, or you can opt for a classic white light for a classy look.

Govee also offers free express shipping so you can get en-light-ened faster and cheaper. Check back often for our rotating Govee discount codes and other offers on this leading lighting brand.
If you’re an essential worker, Govee wants to thank you for your service with exclusive discounts on lighting solutions. Once verified, you’ll get exclusive discounts, and you can even apply for a new discount every month!
